tests.item: USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS - establish, document, implement and maintain
tests.expected_value: The MANUFACTURER shall establish, document, implement and maintain a USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS to provide SAFETY for the PATIENT USER and others.
tests.actual_result: Usability engineering file (document no. CE-PT9L-12, version 1.0); User guide (document no. PT9L-SMSY01, version 1.0)

tests.expected_value: USABILITY ENGINEERING activities shall be planned, carried out, and documented by competent personnel.
tests.actual_result: ISO 13485:2016 complied (document no. SX 2095583-1); Section 1.2 of Usability engineering file (document no. CE-PT9L-12, version 1.0)

tests.item: Product realization PROCESS incorporation of USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS
tests.expected_value: Where a documented product realization PROCESS exists, it shall incorporate or reference the USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS.

tests.item: Interrelationship between RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS and USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS
tests.expected_value: A depiction of the interrelationship between the RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS of ISO 14971:2019 and the USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS shall be shown.
tests.actual_result: ISO 14971:2019 complied; Document No.: PT9L-FXGB01 V1.0

tests.item: Flexible order of activities described in Clause 5
tests.expected_value: Activities may be carried out in a flexible order as appropriate.
tests.actual_result: See usability engineering file (document no. CE-PT9L-12, version 1.0)

tests.item: RISK CONTROL - use-related RISK reduction options
tests.expected_value: To reduce use-related RISK, the MANUFACTURER shall use one or more risk control options in priority order.
tests.actual_result: Complied by inspection of Usability engineering file (document no. CE-PT9L-12, version 1.0)

tests.item: RISK CONTROL option a) - inherent safe design and manufacture
tests.expected_value: Inherent safe design and manufacture applied.
tests.actual_result: Inherent safe design and manufacture complied

tests.item: RISK CONTROL option b) - protective measures in the MEDICAL DEVICE or manufacturing PROCESS
tests.expected_value: Protective measures in the MEDICAL DEVICE itself or in the manufacturing PROCESS.

tests.item: RISK CONTROL option c) - information for SAFETY and training to USERS
tests.expected_value: Information for SAFETY and, where appropriate, training to USERS provided.
tests.actual_result: Instruction for use provided for users

semantic_fragments.content: This document is a Checklist of EN 62366-1:2015+A1:2020 (Medical electrical equipment – Application of usability engineering to medical devices) for the PT9L Infrared Forehead Thermometer. It covers the general requirements under Clause 4 including usability engineering process establishment, risk control as it relates to user interface design, and information for safety as it relates to usability.
